scope: Fresh corrected additive CHARMM/NAMD candidate for preliminary welded-versus-unwelded thermal-stability studies; qualify the candidate in a finite local DNA context before proposing a temperature campaign.

authorization.planning_and_preflight: Authorized and performed; current user requested approval and compute scheduling first.
authorization.first_compute_tranche: Proposed; awaiting user approval of this plan before launch.
authorization.later_compute: Conditional design below, not a runnable queue or authorization receipt. After pilot audit, present measured remaining cost and a finite target manifest for approval.
authorization.technical_audits: One job at a time. Within an approved finite tranche, a passed audit permits the next listed job without another routine permission question; failures, exhausted caps or changed scope require a revised plan.

identity.preserve: Both intrabase C5-C6 bonds, glycosidic and backbone connectivity, all atoms and formal charge.
identity.initial_model: 36-atom neutral N1-methyl capped core; static ETKDG construction, not a QM minimum.
identity.chemical_definition_gate: pending; current static construction and this compute plan do not constitute human identity approval.
identity.reuse: Reuse algorithms, audited parent DNA terms, diagnostics and potentially eligible unwelded controls. Prior anti QM, charges, fits and MD do not certify this corrected stereoisomer.
identity.preservation: Keep all historical native successes, failures, pauses and receipts byte-intact, scoped to their original hashes.

resources_observed.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X; 16 physical cores / 32 logical CPUs
resources_observed.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti, 12288 MiB, 877 MiB, 5 %
resources_observed.observation_scope: Read running user service list; this is not an assertion that all CPU/GPU workloads are absent.

scheduler_proposal.resource_action: Recheck memory, CPU/GPU occupancy and disk before every job. If headroom is insufficient, defer or reduce the reservation with a recorded audit; do not stop unrelated workloads.
scheduler_proposal.scratch: All scratch, native outputs, temporary files and large logs on Archive, including explicit Psi4 IO-manager path and TMPDIR; verify actual file locations in the pilot.
scheduler_proposal.normal_chunk_hours: 1-4 for QM; 2 for NAMD. The per-stage cap below applies even though the global ceiling is 15 h.
scheduler_proposal.checkpoint: Save every completed QM evaluation and accepted optimizer geometry with hashes; Hessian displacement tasks independently checkpointed. MD writes coor/vel/XSC every 100 ps.
scheduler_proposal.restart_limit: An interrupted SCF/gradient may need rerunning. Continue from the last validated geometry if optimizer state cannot be restored; no bitwise-continuity promise. Do not restart a long indivisible calculation blindly.
scheduler_proposal.boundary_admission: Reserve output/checkpoint grace inside the cap; launch a further evaluation only if its conservative measured duration fits before the stop boundary.
audit_each_chunk: peak RSS, wall time and scratch growth
cheaper adequate alternatives or sequential thread benchmark
scheduler_proposal.automation: Fresh versioned job plans and wake tokens only; no unchanged old launcher, blind service chain, automatic cloud offload or automatic retry loop.

first_compute_tranche.meaning: Maximum reservation summed across sequential jobs, not an estimate of completion time and not five core-hours. At four threads this reserves up to 20 allocated core-hours.
first_compute_tranche.method: Psi4 MP2/6-31G(d), density fitting, frozen core; pin engine/version, auxiliary basis and options before execution. Preserve prior E/D 1e-12 and response 1e-10 tolerances.
preparation: Recheck current definition/SDF/map pins and accurate CIP plus signed-coordinate identity.
Prepare a fresh gate-neutral diagnostic job and a product-scoped atom-mapped review packet; do not attach or approve a registry asset.
Adapt old runners to current definition checks, Archive scratch, resource caps and checkpoint behavior; run targeted preflight checks before native QM.

jobs.task: One analytic gradient on the corrected 36-atom core, with finite energy/gradient, units and identity checks; record wall time, peak RSS and scratch footprint.
jobs.proceed_if: Result passes, memory is safe, and measured evaluation cost allows useful bounded optimization.

jobs.task: Unconstrained geometry optimization from the pinned corrected seed; keep electronic state and all four product centers under audit.
jobs.proceed_if: Only after pilot review. Stop at the earlier wall/evaluation limit or convergence. No automatic continuation or second seed in this tranche.

first_compute_tranche.final_review: Check native convergence and independent final gradient, geometry identity, resource use and progress. A stopped or converged optimizer is not harmonic-minimum certification. Report a data-based Hessian/remaining-QM schedule before further compute.

subsequent_stages_proposed.requires: Stationary corrected core and approved post-pilot manifest.
subsequent_stages_proposed.work: Finite differences of analytic gradients at one exact pinned stationary geometry; assemble and independently audit the Hessian, translation/rotation projection and 102 internal modes for this nonlinear 36-atom model. Resolve substantive imaginary modes or numerical ambiguity instead of clipping them.
subsequent_stages_proposed.sizing: Generated displacement count times measured gradient cost; checkpoint completed tasks, audit after each batch. A second seed/basin is a separate finite decision, not an automatic search.
subsequent_stages_proposed.output_claim: Local harmonic minimum at the specified method; not a global-minimum proof.

subsequent_stages_proposed.work: Generate the current product-only exact-geometry identity packet. Rebuild and review both sugar-bearing endpoint boundary models (historically 49 atoms each); verify their actual caps, charge, valences, sugar stereochemistry and term coverage. Freeze the finite training and held-out target membership before acquisition.
subsequent_stages_proposed.compute: Primarily preparation/audit; no inherited approval and no old boundary coordinates reused as validated corrected models.
subsequent_stages_proposed.review: Formal chemical-definition, coupled-conformer and boundary-model review receipts required by the relevant workflow before its curated jobs. User compute approval is separate from these evidence gates.

subsequent_stages_proposed.requires: Approved atom-mapped models, exact target manifest, method/objective and measured total budget.
subsequent_stages_proposed.work: MP2/6-31G(d) reference geometry, changed-bond/angle response, glycosidic scans and coupled ring distortions; HF/6-31G(d) water interactions and dipoles. Fit changed charges and bonded terms while retaining justified parent DNA and LJ terms.
subsequent_stages_proposed.envelope_status: Starting design only; exact geometries, torsions, curve distances, cap coverage and held-out membership must be pinned before launch. Add targets only after residual diagnosis and a revised finite budget. Do not replay the old 94-record contract.
subsequent_stages_proposed.objective_decision: Resolve prior policy discrepancy explicitly: general workflow scales neutral HF dipole vectors by 1.3, whereas preliminary anti policy v2 targets unscaled vectors. Freeze one justified convention and its water/distance/charge constraints before new charge fitting; never mix objectives silently.
subsequent_stages_proposed.modeling_rule: Use coupled conformers/normal-mode displacements for cyclobutane response, not an independent torsion scan through a ring bond. Positive MM curvature alone does not validate force constants.

subsequent_stages_proposed.requires: Frozen parameter candidate hash before held-out QM targets are exposed.
subsequent_stages_proposed.work: Check independent conformer energies/geometries and hydration residuals, with matching QM/MM basin identities. Retain failed targets. A refit turns exposed holdouts into development data and needs a fresh validation design.
subsequent_stages_proposed.acceptance_scope: Explicit proposed local criteria from prior preliminary policy, not universal literature sufficiency or full release. Freeze eligible target membership and energy reference before scoring.

subsequent_stages_proposed.requires: Explicit corrected topology/parameters/templates and passed target checks for preliminary scientific interpretation.
subsequent_stages_proposed.work: Audit full term coverage, charge, crosslinks, ordered product and sugar stereochemistry, clashes, strand/ring piercing, periodic clearance and CPU/NAMD energy-force agreement. Run bounded minimization then 100 ps smoke and a restart check.
subsequent_stages_proposed.output_claim: Engine-testable corrected candidate; smoke success is not thermal equilibration.

subsequent_stages_proposed.requires: Approved candidate and context specification, successful engine audit and a measured GPU pilot.
subsequent_stages_proposed.default_context: Same 2hb_1xT_CPD junction used for the historical controlled comparison, with corrected product placement rebuilt from the unwelded parent; freeze exact endpoints/system protocol before launch. Formation-screen prevalence and model-validation context are separate questions.
subsequent_stages_proposed.control_policy: Reuse the three existing undamaged 10 ns controls only after exact site, forcefield, solvent/ion, cell/preparation, sampling protocol and observable comparability audit. Otherwise propose new matched controls, up to another three times 10 ns. Preserve preparation differences and all outcomes.
subsequent_stages_proposed.forecast_scope: Historical same-machine context rate only; preparation, queue waits and audit time excluded. Rebenchmark with smoke run before accepting this schedule.
subsequent_stages_proposed.output_claim: Preliminary finite-context structural support; no absolute melting temperature, equilibrium or stiffness validation.

subsequent_stages_proposed.requires: Audited corrected candidate, restartable NAMD package and completed finite-context comparison.
subsequent_stages_proposed.work: Propose the actual temperature grid, weld occupancy/placement, sizes, replicas, observables and time limits for welded/unwelded studies.
subsequent_stages_proposed.authorization: Separate concrete schedule; not automatically launched by refinement. Broad registry/app release remains evidence-gated.

approval_checkpoints.decision: Approve only the initial <=5 h native CPU tranche and method/resource/checkpoint policy.
After measured pilot audit, approve finite Hessian and reference-data allocations; finalize model reviews and fitting objective before dependent jobs.
Review frozen candidate, prospective results and exact DNA-context/control reuse audit; approve the bounded GPU allocation.
Review validation package and a separate temperature-campaign design.

review_rule_sources.quote: A correction to any ordered endpoint, atom map, graph bond, signed stereocenter, or source coordinate is a revision and requires regenerated candidate evidence and a new packet.
review_rule_sources.application: The corrected anti graph/stereochemistry invalidates transfer of old exact-geometry reviews. New product-scoped evidence and decisions are needed; do not repeat unrelated isomer work.

review_rule_sources.rule: Human review can pass only the chemical_definition identity gate; later passes require metric evidence.
review_rule_sources.application: No user plan approval or successful optimizer exit is recorded as a QM/minimum/parameter or production-readiness pass.

total_campaign_duration: Not yet estimated reliably. After the gradient pilot, report displacement/scan task counts and measured per-task cost; retain limits and distinguish reservations from runtime estimates.
